chunks: Then he produced for them a calf, a body that had a mooing sound, so they said: 'This is your god and the god of Moses, whom he neglected.'

key_terms.جَسَدٌ: Body (referring to the physical form of the idol)

ai.seo_question: Who created the golden calf and what did the Israelites say about it?
ai.summary: This verse highlights the rapid apostasy of the Children of Israel, where the Samiri fashioned a hollow calf with a lowing sound to deceive them during Moses' prolonged absence on Mount Sinai. In Shia exegesis, this incident underscores the human propensity for idolatry when spiritual leadership is absent, serving as a cautionary tale against blind following (Taqlid) of worldly leaders. The phrase 'he forgot' is interpreted by scholars as referring to Moses' temporary delay in return, which the people exploited to justify their new deity.
